cases.name: Paula Ann Scheppers
cases.about: Her obituary said: "She graduated from Fatima High School before continuing her education at Lincoln University, where she earned her degree. Paula devoted many years of her life to education as a teacher, touching the lives of countless students through her kindness, patience, and dedication. Paula found joy in life's simple pleasures. She loved watching soap operas, antiquing, and shopping for unique treasures. She especially enjoyed collecting Denim Days figurines and cherished her collection of nesting dolls. A familiar face at the Osage County Library, Paula spent many happy hours reading, learning, and visiting with friends."
